issue_title: Pagination returns wrong page when page=0 is passed
issue_body: When calling `/items?page=0`, the API returns page 1 results instead of an error or page 0. The off-by-one in `paginate()` causes this. Failing test: `test_pagination_zero_page`.

minimal.diff_text:
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ def paginate(items, page, per_page=10):
-    start = (page - 1) * per_page
+    start = max(0, (page - 1)) * per_page
     return items[start:start + per_page]
minimal.judge_explanation: Minimal won with the smallest targeted fix (2 lines) that directly addresses the off-by-one error. Root-cause scored lower due to larger diff size.

rootcause.diff_text:
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -10,8 +10,10 @@ def paginate(items, page, per_page=10):
+    if page < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f'page must be >= 1, got {page}')
-    start = (page - 1) * per_page
+    start = (page - 1) * per_page  # page is 1-indexed
     return items[start:start + per_page]
